```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/app-mode.css">

<style>
.ryc-wrap { max-width: 1220px; margin: 0 auto; }
.ryc-wrap, .ryc-wrap * { box-sizing: border-box; }
@media (min-width: 992px) {
  #quarto-margin-sidebar { display: none; }
  #quarto-content main.content { grid-column: page-start-inset / page-end-inset !important; }
}

.ryc-card {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #e0e0e0); border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px 18px; margin-bottom: 16px; background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.ryc-user { font-size: .9rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.ryc-user b { color: var(--site-accent); }
.ryc-intro p { margin: 0 0 10px; }
.ryc-credit { font-size: .85rem; color: #888; border-top: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #e9e9e9); padding-top: 10px; margin-top: 4px; }

/* ---------- progress ---------- */
.ryc-prog-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.ryc-prog-label { font-weight: 700; }
.ryc-prog-label b { color: var(--site-accent); }
.ryc-prog-outer { background: #ececec; border-radius: 6px; height: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.ryc-prog-inner { background: var(--site-accent); height: 100%; width: 0; transition: width .4s; }

/* ---------- buttons ---------- */
.ryc-btn {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--site-accent); color: var(--site-accent); background: transparent;
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: .92rem; cursor: pointer;
}
.ryc-btn:hover { background: var(--site-accent); color: var(--site-accent-contrast); }
.ryc-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
.ryc-btn:disabled:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--site-accent); }
.ryc-btn.primary { background: var(--site-accent); color: var(--site-accent-contrast); }
.ryc-btn.primary:hover { background: var(--site-accent-hover); }
.ryc-btns { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* ---------- syllabus: a level path, one color per part ---------- */
.ryc-part-card { border-top: 3px solid var(--pc, var(--site-accent)); }
.ryc-part-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.ryc-part-title::before {
  content: ''; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--pc, var(--site-accent)); flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ryc-part-count { margin-left: auto; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--pc, #777); opacity: .9; }
.ryc-part-blurb { color: #777; font-size: .9rem; margin: 4px 0 12px; }
.ryc-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-top: 2px; }
.ryc-row {
  position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; width: 100%; text-align: left;
  border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; margin-top: 10px;
  background: transparent; font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer;
}
.ryc-row:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
/* the path: a dashed connector climbing from the previous node, lit solid once it is walked */
.ryc-row::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; left: 28.5px; top: -14px; height: 20px; width: 0;
  border-left: 3px dashed rgba(128,128,128,.38);
}
.ryc-row:first-child::before { display: none; }
.ryc-row.done + .ryc-row::before { border-left-style: solid; border-color: var(--pc, #2E8B57); }
.ryc-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc, #888) 9%, transparent); }
.ryc-row.locked { cursor: default; opacity: .45; }
.ryc-row.locked:hover { background: transparent; }
.ryc-row .rw-num { display: none; }
@keyframes ryc-pulse {
  0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc, #888) 45%, transparent); }
  70%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 9px transparent; }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent; }
}
.ryc-row .rw-mark {
  position: relative; width: 40px; height: 40px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 700;
  border: 2.5px dashed rgba(128,128,128,.5); color: #999;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
/* node states: number waiting on the path, part color when reachable, check when walked */
.ryc-row .rw-mark.done { background: var(--pc, #2E8B57); border: 2.5px solid var(--pc, #2E8B57); color: #fff; }
.ryc-row .rw-mark.open { border: 2.5px solid var(--pc, var(--site-accent)); color: var(--pc, var(--site-accent)); }
.ryc-row.current .rw-mark {
  background: var(--pc, var(--site-accent)); color: #fff;
  animation: ryc-pulse 1.7s ease-out infinite;
}
/* test lessons are the boss levels of their part */
.ryc-row.boss .rw-mark { border-radius: 13px; }
.ryc-row.boss .rw-mark::after {
  content: '\2605'; position: absolute; top: -9px; right: -7px;
  font-size: .85rem; color: var(--pc, #888); -webkit-text-stroke: .5px var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.ryc-row.boss .rw-mark.done::after { color: #F4B400; }
.ryc-row .rw-title { flex: 1; }
.ryc-row.done .rw-title { opacity: .75; }
.ryc-row.current .rw-title { font-weight: 700; }
.ryc-row .rw-src { color: #aaa; font-size: .8rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ---------- lesson ---------- */
.ryc-lesson-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.ryc-lesson-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.ryc-lesson-sub { color: #999; font-size: .9rem; }
.ryc-cols { display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; }
/* The board grows into whatever the text column does not need, but the height cap
   is what matters on a tablet. A lesson is unusable if the prompt and the answer
   buttons sit below the fold, because reading the text and playing the move then
   cost a scroll each way. The subtracted allowance is the measured chrome, roughly
   180px above the board (navbar, lesson header) plus 220px below it (prompt, the
   feedback line, and the buttons, each able to wrap to a second line).
   svh, not vh: on iOS Safari vh is the toolbar-hidden height, so it promises space
   the page does not actually have. The vh line stays first as a fallback for
   browsers that do not know svh. min-width wins over max-width in CSS, so 280px is
   the natural floor below which the page is allowed to scroll again. */
/* The measured 400px allowance still holds in the app shell: the navbar it
   once covered is gone, but the pane's 60px pill padding takes its place. */
.ryc-left { flex: 99 1 430px; min-width: 280px; max-width: min(660px, calc(100vh - 400px)); }
.ryc-left { max-width: min(660px, calc(100svh - 400px)); }
.ryc-right { flex: 1 1 340px; min-width: 280px; max-width: 520px; }
/* On a short screen the height cap can shrink the board past the point where a
   finger can hit a square, so hold a floor from tablet width up. min-width beats
   max-width in CSS, which is what makes this a floor. Phones keep the smaller
   value, because there the column is the full screen and 360px would overflow. */
@media (min-width: 768px) { .ryc-left { min-width: 360px; } }

/* While a lesson is open the page title banner is 100px of pure overhead, which is
   the difference between fitting and not fitting on a 13 inch tablet in landscape. */
body.ryc-focus #title-block-header { display: none; }

.ryc-text p { margin: 0 0 12px; line-height: 1.65; }
.ryc-text p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.ryc-text .ryc-src-tag { font-size: .8rem; color: #aaa; display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; }

/* board */
#rycBoard {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(8, 1fr);
  width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;
  user-select: none; touch-action: none; border: 2px solid #b0b0b0;
}
.ryc-ghost { position: fixed; pointer-events: none; z-index: 999; opacity: .85; }
.ryc-sq { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.ryc-sq img { width: 88%; height: 88%; pointer-events: none; }
.ryc-sq.light { background: #e7e1d4; }
.ryc-sq.dark { background: #5c7d40; }
.ryc-sq.live { cursor: pointer; }
.ryc-sq.sel { outline: 3px solid #f6c144; outline-offset: -3px; }
.ryc-sq.last { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(155, 199, 0, .28); }
.ryc-sq.hintsq { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(70, 130, 180, .38); }
.ryc-sq.goodsq { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(46, 139, 87, .45); }
.ryc-sq.wrongsq { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(204, 0, 0, .35); }
.ryc-sq .dot { position: absolute; width: 26%; height: 26%; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
/* candidate squares for a two-way question */
.ryc-sq.cand::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 3px dashed rgba(70, 130, 180, .85); pointer-events: none;
}

/* exercise chrome */
.ryc-pips { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.ryc-pip { width: 30px; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #e3e3e3; }
.ryc-pip.done { background: #2E8B57; }
.ryc-pip.shown { background: #E0A800; }
.ryc-pip.cur { background: var(--site-accent); }
.ryc-prompt { margin-top: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; }
.ryc-status { min-height: 26px; margin-top: 8px; font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.55; }
.ryc-status .ok { color: #1E6B3E; font-weight: 600; }
.ryc-status .bad { color: #CC0000; font-weight: 600; }
.ryc-status .why { color: #555; }
.ryc-choices { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; margin-top: 10px; }
.ryc-choice {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #e0e0e0); border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 13px;
  background: transparent; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; color: inherit;
}
.ryc-choice:hover { border-color: var(--site-accent); }
.ryc-choice:disabled { cursor: default; }
.ryc-choice.right { border-color: #2E8B57; background: rgba(46, 139, 87, .12); }
.ryc-choice.wrong { border-color: #CC0000; background: rgba(204, 0, 0, .10); }

.ryc-done-note { text-align: center; padding: 18px 12px; line-height: 1.7; }
.ryc-done-note .huge { font-size: 1.9rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; }
</style>

  <div id="rycSyllabus">
    <div class="ryc-card ryc-intro">
      <div class="ryc-user" id="rycUser"></div>
      <p>An imbalance is any significant difference between the two sides. Learn to name the ones in front of you and the plan stops being a matter of taste, because the board tells you what it wants. This course works through them one at a time, then through the pieces, the psychology, and the structures they live in, ending each stretch with tests labeled by rating.</p>
      <p>Every lesson gives you a position to look at, a short read, and a set of exercises you answer on the board itself. Some ask which piece to move, some ask which piece must stay where it is, some ask where a piece belongs, and some ask you to play the move. Finish a lesson and it turns green, which opens the next one.</p>
      <div class="ryc-credit">Positions and course structure follow Jeremy Silman, <i>How to Reassess Your Chess</i>, fourth edition. All explanations here are written for this site.</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('app-menu-btn');
  var menu = document.getElementById('app-menu');
  btn.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    ev.stopPropagation();
    menu.hidden = !menu.hidden;
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!menu.hidden));
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!menu.hidden) {
      menu.hidden = true;
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script type="module">
import { Chess } from './chess-assets/chess.js';

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const todayStr = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA');

/* ---------- identity: the site-wide sign-in ---------- */
const fdb = () => window.__rycFdb || null;
const authP = () => window.__rycAuthP || Promise.resolve(null);
let cloudProfile = null;   // { uid, name } while signed in

/* Course progress lives under the reader's own account. Signed out, this page
   stays entirely local, exactly as before. */
function courseRef() {
  if (!cloudProfile || !fdb()) return null;
  return fdb().ref('users/' + cloudProfile.uid + '/chess/course');
}

const LOCAL_KEY = 'reassess-chess-v1';

/* state = { done: {lessonId: 'YYYY-MM-DD'}, cur: lessonId } */
let state = { done: {}, cur: null };

function loadLocal() {
  try { const v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_KEY)); if (v && v.done) return v; } catch (e) {}
  return { done: {}, cur: null };
}
const saveLocal = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (e) {} };

function mergeStates(a, b) {
  const out = { done: Object.assign({}, a.done), cur: a.cur || b.cur };
  for (const [k, dt] of Object.entries(b.done || {})) if (!out.done[k]) out.done[k] = dt;
  return out;
}
async function cloudLoad() {
  if (!cloudProfile || !fdb()) return null;
  try {
    const v = await Promise.race([
      (async () => {
        const ref = courseRef();
        if (!ref) return undefined;
        const snap = await ref.once('value');
        return snap.val();
      })(),
      new Promise((res, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('timeout')), 8000))
    ]);
    if (v === undefined) return null;
    if (!v) return { done: {}, cur: null };
    return { done: v.done || {}, cur: v.cur || null };
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}
function cloudSave() {
  const ref = courseRef();
  if (!ref) return;
  const payload = { done: state.done, updatedAt: Date.now() };
  if (state.cur) payload.cur = state.cur;
  ref.set(payload).catch(() => {});
}
const persist = () => { saveLocal(); cloudSave(); };

/* ---------- course data ---------- */
let PARTS = [], LESSONS = [];
const doneCount = () => LESSONS.filter(l => state.done[l.id]).length;
const idxOf = id => LESSONS.findIndex(l => l.id === id);
/* A lesson opens once the one before it is done. A lesson you have already
   finished always stays open too, so inserting new lessons into the middle of a
   part never locks work you have completed. */
const isUnlocked = i => i === 0 || !!state.done[LESSONS[i - 1].id] || !!state.done[LESSONS[i].id];
function firstUnfinished() {
  for (let i = 0; i < LESSONS.length; i++) if (!state.done[LESSONS[i].id]) return i;
  return -1;
}

/* ---------- board ---------- */
const FILES = 'abcdefgh';
const BF_TILE = [0,1,2,3,  2,1,0,3,  3,0,1,2,  3,2,1,0];
const boardEl = $('rycBoard');
let game = null, flip = false, selected = null, lastMove = null;
let clickable = null;          /* Set of squares that accept a click, or null for a move exercise */
let boardMode = 'idle';        /* 'idle' | 'move' | 'click' */

function sqName(r, c) { return flip ? FILES[7 - c] + (r + 1) : FILES[c] + (8 - r); }
function drawBoard() {
  boardEl.innerHTML = '';
  const pos = game ? game.board() : null;
  for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
    const sq = document.createElement('div');
    const name = sqName(r, c);
    const bfv = BF_TILE[((+name[1] - 1) % 4) * 4 + (FILES.indexOf(name[0]) % 4)];
    sq.className = 'ryc-sq ' + (((r + c) % 2 === 0) ? 'light' : 'dark') + ' bf-v' + bfv;
    sq.dataset.sq = name;
    const p = pos ? pos[flip ? 7 - r : r][flip ? 7 - c : c] : null;
    if (p) {
      const img = document.createElement('img');
      img.src = 'chess-assets/pieces/' + p.color + p.type.toUpperCase() + '.svg';
      img.alt = p.color + p.type;
      sq.appendChild(img);
    }
    if (lastMove && (name === lastMove.from || name === lastMove.to)) sq.classList.add('last');
    if (selected === name) sq.classList.add('sel');
    if (clickable && clickable.has(name)) sq.classList.add('cand');
    if (boardMode === 'move' || (boardMode === 'click' && (!clickable || clickable.has(name)))) sq.classList.add('live');
    boardEl.appendChild(sq);
  }
}
function markMoves(from) {
  for (const m of game.moves({ square: from, verbose: true })) {
    const cell = boardEl.querySelector(`[data-sq="${m.to}"]`);
    if (cell && !cell.querySelector('.dot')) {
      const dot = document.createElement('div'); dot.className = 'dot'; cell.appendChild(dot);
    }
  }
}
function flash(name, cls, ms) {
  const cell = boardEl.querySelector(`[data-sq="${name}"]`);
  if (!cell) return;
  cell.classList.add(cls);
  setTimeout(() => cell.classList.remove(cls), ms || 750);
}

/* one pointer flow for both input styles: click then click, or press and drag */
let drag = null;
function squareUnder(e) {
  const el = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  const sq = el && el.closest && el.closest('.ryc-sq');
  return sq ? sq.dataset.sq : null;
}
boardEl.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  const name = squareUnder(e);
  if (!name) return;
  if (boardMode === 'click') { e.preventDefault(); answerClick(name); return; }
  if (boardMode !== 'move' || !game) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const piece = game.get(name);
  if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) {
    const again = selected === name;
    selected = name;
    drawBoard(); markMoves(name);
    const img = boardEl.querySelector(`[data-sq="${name}"] img`);
    drag = { from: name, again, moved: false, startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY, ghost: null, src: img ? img.src : null };
  } else if (selected) {
    tryMove(selected, name);
  }
});
document.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  if (!drag) return;
  if (!drag.moved && Math.hypot(e.clientX - drag.startX, e.clientY - drag.startY) > 6) {
    drag.moved = true;
    if (drag.src) {
      const g = document.createElement('img');
      g.src = drag.src; g.className = 'ryc-ghost';
      const s = boardEl.clientWidth / 8 * 0.92;
      g.style.width = s + 'px'; g.style.height = s + 'px';
      document.body.appendChild(g);
      drag.ghost = g;
      const orig = boardEl.querySelector(`[data-sq="${drag.from}"] img`);
      if (orig) orig.style.opacity = .35;
    }
  }
  if (drag.ghost) {
    const s = parseFloat(drag.ghost.style.width);
    drag.ghost.style.left = (e.clientX - s / 2) + 'px';
    drag.ghost.style.top = (e.clientY - s / 2) + 'px';
  }
});
document.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  if (!drag) return;
  const d = drag; drag = null;
  if (d.ghost) d.ghost.remove();
  const orig = boardEl.querySelector(`[data-sq="${d.from}"] img`);
  if (orig) orig.style.opacity = '';
  if (d.moved) {
    const target = squareUnder(e);
    if (target && target !== d.from) tryMove(d.from, target);
    else { selected = null; drawBoard(); }
  } else if (d.again) {
    selected = null; drawBoard();
  }
});
document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
  if (!drag) return;
  if (drag.ghost) drag.ghost.remove();
  drag = null; selected = null; drawBoard();
});

/* ---------- lesson runner ---------- */
/* cur = { i, ei, marks: ['done'|'shown'|null], answered, base } */
let cur = null;
let seq = 0;                                  /* cancels timers from an abandoned exercise */

function setStatus(html) { $('rycStatus').innerHTML = html; }
/* Lesson prose may mark a term with **double asterisks**. Everything is escaped
   first, so the only markup that can reach the page is the bold tag added here. */
function richText(s) {
  return s.replace(/[&<>]/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;' }[c]))
          .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<b>$1</b>');
}
function ex() { return LESSONS[cur.i].ex[cur.ei]; }

function openLesson(i) {
  if (i < 0 || i >= LESSONS.length || !isUnlocked(i)) return;
  const L = LESSONS[i];
  cur = { i, ei: 0, marks: L.ex.map(() => null), answered: false };
  pendingNext = null;
  state.cur = L.id; saveLocal();
  $('rycSyllabus').style.display = 'none';
  $('rycLesson').style.display = '';
  document.body.classList.add('ryc-focus');
  (document.querySelector('.app-pane') || window).scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  $('rycTitle').textContent = L.title;
  $('rycSub').textContent = `Lesson ${i + 1} of ${LESSONS.length}`;
  const txt = $('rycText');
  txt.innerHTML = '';
  if (L.source) {
    const s = document.createElement('span');
    s.className = 'ryc-src-tag';
    s.textContent = L.source;
    txt.appendChild(s);
  }
  for (const p of L.text) {
    const el = document.createElement('p');
    el.innerHTML = richText(p);
    txt.appendChild(el);
  }
  (document.querySelector('.app-pane') || window).scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  startExercise();
}

function renderPips() {
  const el = $('rycPips');
  el.innerHTML = '';
  cur.marks.forEach((m, k) => {
    const p = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'ryc-pip' + (m ? ' ' + m : (k === cur.ei ? ' cur' : ''));
    el.appendChild(p);
  });
}

function startExercise() {
  const L = LESSONS[cur.i], e = ex();
  seq++;
  const mySeq = seq;
  cur.answered = false;
  flip = !!L.flip;
  game = new Chess(L.fen);
  selected = null; lastMove = null; clickable = null;
  $('rycChoices').innerHTML = '';
  setStatus('');
  $('rycPrompt').textContent = e.prompt;
  renderPips();
  $('rycNext').style.display = 'none';
  $('rycShow').style.display = '';
  $('rycRetry').style.display = e.kind === 'choice' ? 'none' : '';
  $('rycShow').disabled = false;

  /* whatever the kind, an exercise may first play some moves out on the board, so
     that it can ask its question about a position further down the line */
  const askIt = () => {
    if (e.kind === 'choice') {
      boardMode = 'idle';
      const box = $('rycChoices');
      e.options.forEach((opt, k) => {
        const b = document.createElement('button');
        b.className = 'ryc-choice';
        b.textContent = opt;
        b.onclick = () => answerChoice(k);
        box.appendChild(b);
      });
    } else if (e.kind === 'piece' || e.kind === 'square') {
      boardMode = 'click';
      if (e.pick) clickable = new Set(e.pick);
    } else {
      boardMode = 'move';
      setStatus(sideToMoveNote());
    }
    drawBoard();
  };

  boardMode = 'idle';
  drawBoard();
  if (e.pre && e.pre.length) {
    setStatus('Watch the moves so far&hellip;');
    let k = 0;
    const step = () => {
      if (mySeq !== seq) return;
      if (k >= e.pre.length) { setStatus(''); askIt(); return; }
      const u = e.pre[k++];
      game.move({ from: u.slice(0, 2), to: u.slice(2, 4), promotion: u[4] || 'q' });
      lastMove = { from: u.slice(0, 2), to: u.slice(2, 4) };
      drawBoard();
      setTimeout(step, 650);
    };
    setTimeout(step, 500);
  } else {
    askIt();
  }
}
function sideToMoveNote() {
  return (game.turn() === 'w' ? 'White' : 'Black') + ' to move.';
}

/* ---------- answering ---------- */
function markRight(whyHtml, extra) {
  cur.answered = true;
  if (!cur.marks[cur.ei]) cur.marks[cur.ei] = 'done';
  boardMode = 'idle'; clickable = null; selected = null;
  renderPips();
  $('rycShow').style.display = 'none';
  $('rycRetry').style.display = 'none';
  setStatus(`<span class="ok">${extra || 'Correct.'}</span> <span class="why">${whyHtml}</span>`);
  const last = cur.ei >= LESSONS[cur.i].ex.length - 1;
  const btn = $('rycNext');
  btn.style.display = '';
  btn.textContent = last ? 'Finish the lesson' : 'Next exercise';
  drawBoard();
}
function markWrong(msg) {
  setStatus(`<span class="bad">${msg || 'Not this one. Try again.'}</span>`);
}

function answerChoice(k) {
  if (cur.answered) return;
  const e = ex();
  const btns = $('rycChoices').querySelectorAll('.ryc-choice');
  if (k !== e.ok) {
    btns[k].classList.add('wrong');
    markWrong();
    return;
  }
  btns.forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
  btns[e.ok].classList.add('right');
  markRight(e.why);
}

function answerClick(name) {
  if (cur.answered) return;
  const e = ex();
  if (clickable && !clickable.has(name)) return;
  if (e.kind === 'piece' && !game.get(name)) { markWrong('There is no piece on that square.'); return; }
  if (e.ok.includes(name)) {
    flash(name, 'goodsq', 1200);
    markRight(e.why);
    return;
  }
  flash(name, 'wrongsq');
  markWrong();
}

function tryMove(from, to) {
  const e = ex();
  const legal = game.moves({ square: from, verbose: true }).some(m => m.to === to);
  if (!legal) { selected = null; drawBoard(); return; }
  const uciBase = from + to;
  const hit = e.ok.find(u => u.slice(0, 4) === uciBase);
  if (!hit) {
    /* show the wrong move briefly, then take it back */
    const undoMe = game.move({ from, to, promotion: 'q' });
    selected = null; lastMove = { from, to };
    boardMode = 'idle';
    drawBoard();
    flash(to, 'wrongsq');
    markWrong();
    const mySeq = ++seq;
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (mySeq !== seq) return;
      if (undoMe) game.undo();
      lastMove = null; boardMode = 'move';
      drawBoard();
    }, 700);
    return;
  }
  const mv = game.move({ from, to, promotion: hit[4] || 'q' });
  selected = null; lastMove = { from, to };
  const played = mv ? mv.san : uciBase;
  drawBoard();
  const alt = (e.okSan && e.okSan.length > 1) ? ` ${played} is one of them.` : '';
  if (e.then && e.then.length) {
    boardMode = 'idle';
    setStatus(`<span class="ok">Correct.${alt}</span> Watch what follows&hellip;`);
    const mySeq = ++seq;
    let k = 0;
    const step = () => {
      if (mySeq !== seq) return;
      if (k >= e.then.length) { markRight(e.why, 'Correct.' + alt); return; }
      const u = e.then[k++];
      game.move({ from: u.slice(0, 2), to: u.slice(2, 4), promotion: u[4] || 'q' });
      lastMove = { from: u.slice(0, 2), to: u.slice(2, 4) };
      drawBoard();
      setTimeout(step, 700);
    };
    setTimeout(step, 700);
  } else {
    markRight(e.why, 'Correct.' + alt);
  }
}

/* ---------- controls ---------- */
$('rycRetry').onclick = () => { if (cur) startExercise(); };
$('rycShow').onclick = () => {
  if (!cur || cur.answered) return;
  const e = ex();
  cur.marks[cur.ei] = 'shown';
  if (e.kind === 'choice') {
    const btns = $('rycChoices').querySelectorAll('.ryc-choice');
    btns.forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
    btns[e.ok].classList.add('right');
    markRight(e.why, 'The answer is shown above.');
    return;
  }
  if (e.kind === 'piece' || e.kind === 'square') {
    e.ok.forEach(s => flash(s, 'hintsq', 1600));
    markRight(e.why, `The answer is ${e.ok.join(' or ')}.`);
    return;
  }
  const u = e.ok[0];
  flash(u.slice(0, 2), 'hintsq', 1600);
  flash(u.slice(2, 4), 'hintsq', 1600);
  markRight(e.why, `The move is ${(e.okSan && e.okSan[0]) || u}.`);
};
/* When a lesson has just been completed the Next button starts the following one
   instead of advancing an exercise. pendingNext holds that lesson index. */
let pendingNext = null;
$('rycNext').onclick = () => {
  if (pendingNext !== null) { const n = pendingNext; pendingNext = null; openLesson(n); return; }
  if (!cur) return;
  const L = LESSONS[cur.i];
  if (cur.ei < L.ex.length - 1) { cur.ei++; startExercise(); return; }
  /* lesson finished */
  if (!state.done[L.id]) state.done[L.id] = todayStr();
  const nxt = cur.i + 1;
  state.cur = nxt < LESSONS.length ? LESSONS[nxt].id : L.id;
  persist();
  finishLesson(nxt);
};
$('rycBack').onclick = () => { seq++; cur = null; boardMode = 'idle'; showSyllabus(); };
$('rycContinue').onclick = () => {
  const i = firstUnfinished();
  if (i < 0) { (document.querySelector('.app-pane') || window).scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); return; }
  openLesson(i);
};
$('rycReset').onclick = () => {
  if (!confirm('Clear your progress on this course? The lessons all lock again except the first.')) return;
  state = { done: {}, cur: null };
  persist();
  showSyllabus();
};

function finishLesson(nxt) {
  seq++;
  boardMode = 'idle';
  cur = null;
  $('rycChoices').innerHTML = '';
  $('rycShow').style.display = 'none';
  $('rycRetry').style.display = 'none';
  $('rycPrompt').textContent = '';
  const more = nxt < LESSONS.length;
  setStatus(`<div class="ryc-done-note"><span class="huge">&#10003;</span>` +
            `<b>Lesson complete.</b><br>` +
            (more ? `Lesson ${nxt + 1}, ${LESSONS[nxt].title}, is now unlocked.`
                  : `That is the last lesson in this part. More parts are on the way.`) +
            `</div>`);
  const btn = $('rycNext');
  btn.style.display = more ? '' : 'none';
  btn.textContent = 'Start the next lesson';
  pendingNext = more ? nxt : null;
}

/* ---------- syllabus render ---------- */
function showSyllabus() {
  pendingNext = null;
  $('rycLesson').style.display = 'none';
  $('rycSyllabus').style.display = '';
  document.body.classList.remove('ryc-focus');
  renderSyllabus();
  (document.querySelector('.app-pane') || window).scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}
function renderSyllabus() {
  const n = doneCount(), total = LESSONS.length;
  $('rycProgLabel').innerHTML = `<b>${n}</b> of ${total} lessons complete`;
  $('rycProg').style.width = total ? (100 * n / total).toFixed(1) + '%' : '0%';
  const cont = $('rycContinue');
  const nextI = firstUnfinished();
  cont.textContent = nextI < 0 ? 'Course complete' : (n === 0 ? 'Start the course' : 'Continue');
  cont.disabled = nextI < 0;
  $('rycReset').style.display = n === 0 ? 'none' : '';

  const host = $('rycParts');
  host.innerHTML = '';
  /* one color per part along the path; these carry grouping meaning, not branding */
  const PART_COLORS = ['#5B5BD6', '#0284C7', '#059669', '#65A30D', '#D97706', '#DC2626',
                       '#DB2777', '#7C3AED', '#0D9488', '#EA580C', '#C026D3'];
  const curI = nextI;
  let pi = -1;
  for (const part of PARTS) {
    pi += 1;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'ryc-card ryc-part-card';
    card.style.setProperty('--pc', PART_COLORS[pi % PART_COLORS.length]);
    const h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = 'ryc-part-title';
    h.textContent = part.title;
    const pdone = part.lessons.filter(lid => state.done[lid]).length;
    const count = document.createElement('span');
    count.className = 'ryc-part-count';
    count.textContent = `${pdone} / ${part.lessons.length}`;
    h.appendChild(count);
    const b = document.createElement('div');
    b.className = 'ryc-part-blurb';
    b.textContent = part.blurb;
    const rows = document.createElement('div');
    rows.className = 'ryc-rows';
    card.appendChild(h); card.appendChild(b); card.appendChild(rows);

    for (const lid of part.lessons) {
      const i = idxOf(lid);
      if (i < 0) continue;
      const L = LESSONS[i];
      const done = !!state.done[L.id], open = isUnlocked(i);
      const boss = /\btest \d/i.test(L.title);
      const row = document.createElement(open ? 'button' : 'div');
      row.className = 'ryc-row' + (done ? ' done' : '') + (open ? '' : ' locked')
        + (i === curI ? ' current' : '') + (boss ? ' boss' : '');
      if (open) row.type = 'button';
      const mark = done ? '&#10003;' : (open ? String(i + 1) : '&#128274;');
      row.innerHTML =
        `<span class="rw-num">${i + 1}</span>` +
        `<span class="rw-mark ${done ? 'done' : (open ? 'open' : '')}">${mark}</span>` +
        `<span class="rw-title"></span>` +
        `<span class="rw-src">${L.source || ''}</span>`;
      row.querySelector('.rw-title').textContent = L.title;
      if (open) {
        row.onclick = () => openLesson(i);
        row.title = done ? 'Completed. Click to run through it again.' : 'Click to start this lesson.';
      } else {
        row.title = 'Finish the lesson before it to unlock this one.';
      }
      rows.appendChild(row);
    }
    host.appendChild(card);
  }
}

/* ---------- boot ---------- */
(function init() {
  function renderUser() {
    if (cloudProfile) {
      $('rycUser').innerHTML = 'Working through this as <b></b> (synced to your account)';
      $('rycUser').querySelector('b').textContent = cloudProfile.name;
    } else {
      $('rycUser').innerHTML = 'Progress is stored in this browser only. Sign in at the top of the page to sync it across devices.';
    }
  }
  renderUser();

  state = loadLocal();

  fetch('chess-assets/course-lessons.json')
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
      PARTS = data.parts; LESSONS = data.lessons;
      renderSyllabus();
    })
    .catch(() => { $('rycProgLabel').textContent = 'The course could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.'; });

  function pullCloud() {
    cloudLoad().then(cloud => {
      if (!cloud) return;
      const merged = mergeStates(state, cloud);
      const changed = JSON.stringify(merged) !== JSON.stringify(state);
      state = merged;
      persist();
      if (changed && LESSONS.length && !cur) renderSyllabus();
    });
  }

  /* Sign-in can settle after this page has painted, so the cloud copy merges in
     whenever identity arrives rather than being read once at start. */
  let wiredUid = null;
  if (window.siteAuth) {
    window.siteAuth.onChange(user => {
      cloudProfile = user
        ? { uid: user.uid, name: window.siteAuth.handle() || 'Player' }
        : null;
      renderUser();
      if (cloudProfile && wiredUid !== cloudProfile.uid) {
        wiredUid = cloudProfile.uid;
        pullCloud();
      }
    });
  }
})();
</script>
```
